text.printed:
Yaka Arrow cannot be attached to cards unless it is in play. While Yaka Arrow is attached to Yondu, he gets +1 THW and +1 ATK.
Forced Interrupt: When attached enemy would be defeated, attach Yaka Arrow to an enemy, to your identity, or add it to your hand.
